Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

tawny adjective

also tan (colour), sandy (hair)

classical

Traupman 252

fulvus, fulva, fulvum

tawny, reddish yellow

Traupman: dull yellow with a mixture of grey and brown; also his word for tan, sandy hair and strawberry blond.

Other words

  • cervīnus, cervīna, cervīnum — deer-coloured, a darker tawny

    also used · classical · Traupman 252

    In Lewis & Short only “of a deer” (pellis, Hor. Ep. 1.2.66); we have found no classical instance of it as a colour.

See also brown, yellow.

SourcesJohn C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
